customer_feedback: The onboarding flow was smooth and the dashboard is intuitive. Love the real-time analytics!
Pricing feels too high for a small team. We ended up postponing renewal until budget review.
Support responded within minutes and fixed my data export issue the same day. Excellent service.
The mobile app keeps crashing when I open reports. Very frustrating during client meetings.
Decent product but I wish there was an integration with Slack. Would pay extra for it.
Reports take forever to load once my dataset grows past 50k rows. Performance needs work.
Great value compared to CompetitorX which charges double for similar features.
I don't understand the sentiment scores. The documentation is confusing and examples are missing.
Love the new API! Automated our weekly customer feedback digest in one afternoon.
Considered switching to DataPulse because their trial offered free migration help. We stayed only because switching costs felt risky.
CSV import fails silently when columns have accents. Had to re-upload three times.
The team collaboration features are a standout. Comments and shared views save us hours every week.
Okay product. Does what it says, nothing surprising either way.
Cancellation process was unclear and I got billed twice. Fixed now but it nearly cost us the contract.
Would love offline access for field work. Our consultants travel a lot without reliable internet.
Onboarding took weeks because we needed custom SSO. Standard login worked fine though.
Sentiment accuracy improved after the last update. Fewer misclassified reviews now.
Too expensive versus CompetitorX. Their entry tier undercuts us and customers notice.
Fantastic webinar series. The advanced filtering tutorial immediately improved how we segment customers.
Dashboard export to PDF loses formatting. Chart labels get cut off constantly.
Reliable uptime so far. No outages in four months of daily use.
Wished the free trial lasted longer. Two weeks wasn't enough to test with real customer data.
The competitor tracking feature is unique - nobody else shows side-by-side review sentiment like this.
Slow responses from support last month, but they resolved everything eventually.
Mobile notifications are useless, half of them are wrong. Disabled all alerts.
